options.content: **TPR / FPR / FNR are not shown here.** They need labelled ground truth (attack vs benign) and are computed offline in `Configurations/analysis`. This dashboard shows what Suricata actually fired: alert volume, top signatures, severities, categories and talkers. Sensor: `viper-suricata-b` (VLAN 20 / Bravo).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "suricata_alerts" and r._field == "count")
  |> group(columns: ["severity"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "sev " + r.severity }))

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "suricata_alerts" and r._field == "count")
  |> group(columns: ["signature", "category"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> rename(columns: { _value: "alerts" })
  |> sort(columns: ["alerts"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 20)
  |> keep(columns: ["signature", "category", "alerts"])

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "suricata_alerts" and r._field == "count")
  |> group(columns: ["category"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> rename(columns: { category: "_field" })

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "suricata_alerts" and r._field == "count")
  |> group(columns: ["severity"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "sev " + r.severity }))

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "suricata_alerts" and r._field == "count")
  |> group(columns: ["src_ip"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> rename(columns: { _value: "alerts" })
  |> sort(columns: ["alerts"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 15)
  |> keep(columns: ["src_ip", "alerts"])

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "suricata_alerts" and r._field == "count")
  |> group(columns: ["dest_ip"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> rename(columns: { _value: "alerts" })
  |> sort(columns: ["alerts"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 15)
  |> keep(columns: ["dest_ip", "alerts"])

panels.title: Sensor throughput: packets vs kernel drops

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "suricata_stats" and (r._field == "pkts" or r._field == "drops"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
